questions.question: What did the people ask Rehoboam to do at Shechem?
options: Lighten the heavy yoke his father placed on them
Lead them out to war against the whole land of Egypt
Move the capital city away from Jerusalem
Build a new temple of the LORD in the north
questions.answer: Lighten the heavy yoke his father placed on them

questions.question: Whose advice did Rehoboam follow?
options: His mother and the queen's court
The elders who had advised his father
The prophets who served the LORD
The young men he grew up with
questions.answer: The young men he grew up with

questions.question: As a result, the northern tribes of Israel rebelled against the house of David.
Rehoboam said his little finger was thicker than his father's _____.
The people cried, 'What portion do we have in _____?' and went to their tents.
